entities.summary: Gaetano Victor Molinari was an American lawyer and Republican politician from New York City. He represented Staten Island in the United States House of Representatives for four terms (1981–1989) and then served 12 years as Staten Island borough president (1990–2002). His daughter, Susan Molinari, also served as a U.S. representative.
